elements.name: iap.buy

parameters.name: options
parameters.doc: optional parameters as properties. The following parameters can be set

elements.examples:
local function iap_listener(self, transaction, error)
    if error == nil then
      -- purchase is successful.
      print(transaction.date)
      -- required if auto finish transactions is disabled in project settings
      if (transaction.state == iap.TRANS_STATE_PURCHASED) then
        -- do server-side verification of purchase here..
        iap.finish(transaction)
      end
    else
      print(error.error, error.reason)
    end
  end

  function init(self)
      iap.set_listener(iap_listener)
      iap.buy("my_iap")
  end

elements.name: iap.finish
elements.description: Explicitly finish a product transaction. [icon:attention] Calling iap.finish is required on a successful transaction if `auto_finish_transactions` is disabled in project settings. Calling this function with `auto_finish_transactions` set will be ignored and a warning is printed. The `transaction.state` field must equal `iap.TRANS_STATE_PURCHASED`.

parameters.name: transaction
parameters.doc: transaction table parameter as supplied in listener callback

elements.name: iap.acknowledge
elements.description: Acknowledge a transaction. [icon:attention] Calling iap.acknowledge is required on a successful transaction on Google Play unless iap.finish is called. The transaction.state field must equal iap.TRANS_STATE_PURCHASED.

parameters.name: transaction
parameters.doc: transaction table parameter as supplied in listener callback

elements.name: iap.list
elements.description: Get a list of all avaliable iap products.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.doc: table (array) of identifiers to get products from

parameters.name: callback
parameters.doc: result callback taking the following parameters

fields.name: products
fields.doc: a table describing the available iap products.

fields.name: error
fields.doc: a table containing error information. `nil` if there is no error. - `error` (the error message)

elements.examples:
local function iap_callback(self, products, error)
    if error == nil then
      for k,p in pairs(products) do
        -- present the product
        print(p.title)
        print(p.description)
      end
    else
      print(error.error)
    end
  end

  function init(self)
      iap.list({"my_iap"}, iap_callback)
  end

returnvalues.name: success
returnvalues.doc: value is `true` if current store supports handling restored transactions, otherwise `false`.

elements.name: iap.set_listener
elements.description: Set the callback function to receive purchase transaction events.

parameters.name: listener
parameters.doc: listener callback function. Pass an empty function if you no longer wish to receive callbacks.

fields.name: error
fields.doc:
a table containing error information. `nil` if there is no error. `error` - the error message. `reason` - the reason for the error, value can be one of the following constants
- `iap.REASON_UNSPECIFIED`
- `iap.REASON_USER_CANCELED`
- `iap.REASON_ITEM_ALREADY_OWNED`

elements.name: iap.REASON_ITEM_ALREADY_OWNED
elements.brief: the item is already owned by the user
elements.description: the item is already owned by the user

elements.name: iap.TRANS_STATE_PURCHASING
elements.brief: transaction purchasing state This is an intermediate mode followed by TRANS_STATE_PURCHASED. Store provider support dependent.
elements.description: transaction purchasing state This is an intermediate mode followed by TRANS_STATE_PURCHASED. Store provider support dependent.

elements.name: iap.TRANS_STATE_RESTORED
elements.brief: transaction restored state This is only available on store providers supporting restoring purchases.
elements.description: transaction restored state This is only available on store providers supporting restoring purchases.

elements.name: iap.TRANS_STATE_UNVERIFIED
elements.brief: transaction unverified state, requires verification of purchase
